method.name: citywide_earliest_scheduled_date
method.description: Citywide opening_date is the earliest non-canceled scheduled Date across enabled Seattle theaters after collapsing variants to parent film identity. A film is a member when week_start <= opening_date <= week_end (Pacific Monday–Sunday). Current showtimes join visibility metadata only. opening_type is soft QA classification (theatrical/repertory/event/limited) and does not affect membership.
